messages:
maya_pm: kicking off a short sync on a 'pin auto-roll policy' proposal. want minimal safe defaults and clear launch gates so we can pilot with a handful of tenants.

noah_eng: outline request: store per-pin policy (ttl, canary_pct, bench_id, retry_policy). expose API so SEs can trigger or cancel.

sasha_research: bench idea: 'pilot-lite' suite with 6 golden prompts + 15 embed anchors. compute a quality_delta = weighted(sum(semantics, embed_drift, rerank_diff)). pass if quality_delta <= 0.04.

maya_pm: proposed gates: bench pass, p99 latency delta <= 2%, embed cosine drift <= 1%, cost delta <= 8%. exclude tenants with explicit contract pins.

olivia_support: comms: send notices at 30/14/7/2 days with a "Preview canary" link. provide quick summary and an opt-out toggle. SEs need a 'run canary now' action.

tina_engineering: infra notes: small canaries are noisy for p99 due to cold KV caches. require synthetic warmup prefixes and prefer canary_pct >= 1%. also add phased promotion: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

infra_bot: scheduled_canary tenant=pilot-cohort-3 start=4076543305 status=running. run_id=rr-4076543305.

noah_eng: next steps: I will draft the API schema + epic. sasha -> bench PR, olivia -> comms templates, tina -> warmup + orchestration plan. target: pilot sign-off in 2 weeks.

maya_pm: perfect. keep thread for updates. :thumbsup:
